summary.en-US: Liquid glass and image or video backgrounds for AI websites. Built for Firefox.

description.en-US: Liquid glass with adjustable transparency, light and dark themes, bundled fonts, and image or video backgrounds. Includes focus mode, cinema width, history blur, sensitive text masking, message queues, and preferred models where supported. Separate controls hide promotions, usage notices, and AI disclaimers. Supports ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok, Qwen, Google AI Studio, DeepSeek, and Hugging Face. Preferences use browser storage and Firefox Sync. Uploaded backgrounds stay local.

release_notes.en-US:
- Added Northern Lights, Dawn, and Ember backgrounds. Replaced Blue with Deep Ocean.
- Enabled Aurora throughout all eight supported websites, including sign-in and welcome pages.
- Added material support for ChatGPT's signed-out Octane layout.
- Settings now stay shared until a website has its own customization, and matching values become shared again automatically.
- Combined glass appearance into one Clear to Dimmed slider and added the selected background to the settings preview.
- Added a full-frame launch demo featuring every website and built-in background.

version.approval_notes: AGPL-3.0-only extension with readable JavaScript and CSS. No build-time transpilation, analytics, or remote executable code. unlimitedStorage supports local user-selected backgrounds within a 15 MB file limit. Host access applies site-specific appearance and features. License and third-party notices are included. Gecko ID is aurora-universal@pigeonlabs. Remote wallpaper loads directly from its provider.
